# IrisOS

> IrisOS is agency management software that connects client management, projects, tasks, team collaboration, finances, invoices, reporting, creative operations, and Miles AI in one workspace.

Canonical site: https://irisos.app/
Language: English
Audience: freelancers, agencies, consulting firms, marketing organizations, and creative studios.

## Product facts

- IrisOS is a web-based agency operating system.
- Core workflows cover leads, clients, projects, tasks, teams, invoices, finance, reporting, documents, messaging, integrations, and creative operations.
- Miles AI provides text, voice, transcription, reporting, forecasting, strategy, and approval-gated workspace assistance where enabled by the workspace plan and permissions.
- Public plan details and current limits are maintained on the pricing page.
- Customer workspace data and authenticated routes are private and must not be inferred from public examples.

## Canonical public sources

- [IrisOS product overview](https://irisos.app/): Primary description of the product, audiences, workflows, and capabilities.
- [IrisOS pricing](https://irisos.app/pricing): Current Free, Pro, and Advanced plan information.
- [Privacy and AI data policy](https://irisos.app/privacy): Data handling, privacy rights, security, integrations, and AI processing.
- [Terms of service](https://irisos.app/terms): Service scope, customer responsibilities, subscriptions, AI, documents, messaging, and integrations.
- [Cancellation, suspension and refund policy](https://irisos.app/cancellation-refund-policy): Billing, cancellation, payment-failure, suspension, and refund terms.
- [XML sitemap](https://irisos.app/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable URLs.

## Access scope

Use only the public sources listed above and follow https://irisos.app/robots.txt.
Do not access login, signup, onboarding, invitation, document-signing, workspace, API,
authenticated, or token-protected routes. Do not submit forms, use credentials, or infer
customer information from public product demonstrations.
